description: Project-wide named 2D physics layers (Godot 'Layer Names'). Layer N occupies bit value 2^(N-1). Scenes, converters and the editor reference these names; collisionLayer/collisionMask values may only use bits defined here.

layers.name: world
layers.description: Solid world geometry: wall tiles and StaticBody2D props (trees, houses, rocks, chests).

layers.name: pickup-seeker
layers.description: Area2D that collects pickups (the player's pickup radius).

layers.name: pickup
layers.description: Area2D of a collectible that can be picked up.

layers.name: trigger
layers.description: World trigger Area2Ds (exits, navigation and encounter areas).

layers.name: water
layers.description: Water tiles. Blocks walking bodies (player, enemies, NPCs include it in their mask) but not projectiles, which fly over water.
